items.title: ADR: separation of human duties across XLSX approval, review and publication
items.why: Only token kind and scopes are separated; one actor can approve, extract, review and publish (review finding, ADR-265 'not decided').

items.title: ADR: revocation of an unexpired Email XLSX approval or review
items.why: Approval and review rows are immutable for their hour with no cancel route, unlike the PDF path; no ADR records the difference.

items.title: ADR: should an idempotent XLSX publish replay return its receipt after expiry
items.why: Currentness is checked before the receipt lookup, so a retried successful publish after expiry returns Conflict; changing it trades retry safety against post-revocation reads.

items.title: Run the immutable-image XLSX worker and browser accessibility gates
items.why: PR #245 listed both as merge gates; the owner waived them at merge (2026-10-21). Neither has run.

items.title: Make donor-parity tests find the pinned donor checkout
items.why: Tests look for a sibling named FOS-Master; on the owner's machine the clone has a different folder name, so ~31 parity tests always skip (a scan that examined nothing).

_note: The single queue of deferred committed work for development sessions (Rule 29). Product backlog that lives in GitHub issues or docs/ is not copied here; an item lands here when a session defers work it committed to.
